subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Design
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fabricate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Design"** means to create, plan, or arrange something with a specific purpose or intention. (डिजाइन करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She decided to design a new dress for the upcoming party.
 
 
 
• **"Fabricate" **refers to making or creating something, often with skill and ingenuity. (गठन करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The engineers fabricated a prototype of the new machine to test its functionality.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fabricate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Destroy **(विनाश करना): To put an end to the existence of something by damaging or attacking it.

 
 
• **Example:** The fire destroyed several homes in the neighborhood.
 
 
 
• **Inspect **(निरीक्षण करना): To examine something carefully, especially for flaws or defects.
 
 
• **Example: **The manager will inspect the work to ensure it meets the company's standards.
 
 
 
• **Copy** (प्रतिलिपि): To reproduce or make a duplicate of something.
 
 
• **Example:** He made a copy of the report for his records.
